help.title: CSV format
help.phone: phone — required. Full international number with country code, e.g. +85291234567. The header may also be phonee164 or phone_e164.
help.name: name — optional. The header may also be fullname. If a name contains a comma, wrap it in double quotes: "Chan, Tai Man".
help.language: preferred_language — optional. Only en or zh_hk are accepted; any other value is imported as blank. The header may also be language or lang.
help.tags: tags — optional. Separate tags with a semicolon, e.g. VIP;Lunch. Up to {maxTagsPerRow} tags per row, 40 characters per tag, and 50 new tags per import. The header may also be tag.
help.limits: Up to {maxRows, number} rows per file. Column order does not matter and header names are not case-sensitive.

errors.missing_date: Include {token} so the customer knows the day.
errors.missing_time: Include {token} so the customer knows the time.
errors.placeholder_at_edge: Start and end the message with words, not a detail. WhatsApp rejects it otherwise.
errors.duplicate_placeholder: {detail} appears more than once. Use each detail once.

warnings.low_ratio_en: Few words around the details ({detail} per detail). WhatsApp may reject it; aim for 3 or more.
warnings.low_ratio_zh_hk: Few characters around the details ({detail} per detail). WhatsApp may reject it; aim for 6 or more.
warnings.promotional_term: “{detail}” can read as marketing. WhatsApp may reject a booking message that uses it.

candidate.pendingNote: {language}: your edit is waiting for WhatsApp approval.
candidate.failedNote: {language}: your edit didn't reach WhatsApp. Open the editor and save again.
candidate.oldInUse: The previous approved version is still in use.

agent.title: Bookings from AI agents
agent.hint: Let diners' AI assistants request a table for them. The diner confirms on WhatsApp from the same number before the request appears under Bookings.
agent.websiteHostHint: The host where you will put poppy.json, for example www.yourrestaurant.hk
agent.downloadHint: Upload this file to your website at https://{host}/.well-known/poppy.json. Agents find your booking page there.
agent.noWhatsappNumber: Add your WhatsApp number to the restaurant first. Diners confirm agent bookings on WhatsApp, so poppy.json can't be used without it.
agent.rotateHint: The old address stops working at once. Download and upload poppy.json again afterwards.
agent.rotated: New agent booking address created. Upload the new poppy.json.
agent.rotateFailed: Couldn't change the agent booking address.

errors.invalid_host: Use a website address like www.yourrestaurant.hk (no path).

bookingHours.title: Booking hours
bookingHours.hint: Diners can only pick times in these periods. "Last booking" is the latest seating time, not closing time.
bookingHours.notConfigured: Off: diners can pick any date and time. The table time, booking terms and restaurant info below still apply.
bookingHours.closedHint: Closed all day; diners cannot pick this day
bookingHours.copyNote: Copies are not saved until you press Save.
bookingHours.copyHint: Use "Copy to…" to copy one day's periods to every day, or to Mon–Fri.
bookingHours.aheadHint: The furthest date diners can book
bookingHours.specialHint: Holidays and days off: closed, or their own periods. They replace that weekday's hours.
bookingHours.partyLine: Diners see: "More than {max}? Message us on WhatsApp"
bookingHours.tableTimeHint: Shown only; it does not block other bookings
bookingHours.tableOption: {minutes, select, 90 {90 min} 120 {2 hours} 150 {2.5 hours} 180 {3 hours} other {# min}}
bookingHours.termsHint: When set, diners must tick "I agree" to book; the AI assistant and personal agents pass them on too.
bookingHours.infoHint: Shown at the top of the booking page.
bookingHours.summaryTitle: The rules diners, the AI assistant and personal agents see
bookingHours.summaryNone: The rules appear here once booking hours are saved.
bookingHours.previewStale: Preview shows the last saved settings.
bookingHours.notSaved: Not saved: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix.

errors.last_before_first: {period}: the last booking must be after the first ({first}).
errors.past: This date has passed; remove it.
errors.invalid_https_url: Use a link starting with https://

limits.title: Guest limits
limits.hint: Only limits online, AI assistant and personal-agent bookings. Staff confirmations are not limited. Leave empty for no limit.
limits.perSlotHint: Guests arriving at the same time
limits.perMealHint: All time slots of lunch or dinner added up
limits.example: Example: 19:00 already has 28 guests and a party of 4 asks for 19:00 → it shows "Full" and suggests other times. Pending and confirmed bookings both count.

errors.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999, or leave it empty.
errors.above_meal: Can't be more than the guests per meal.

payments.title: Payments
payments.hint: Deposits are paid into your restaurant's own Stripe account. OhMyClient never holds the money.
payments.adminOnly: Only admins can connect a payment account.

reason.past_due: Stripe needs more information before this account can take payments.
reason.rejected: Stripe rejected this account. Check your Stripe dashboard.
reason.deauthorized: This Stripe account was disconnected. Connect again to take deposits.
reason.other: Stripe has paused payments on this account ({reason}).

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.hint: Diners pay a deposit to send their booking. The seats are held for 30 minutes while they pay.
deposit.paused: Stripe isn't active, so new bookings are taken without a deposit until it is.
deposit.summaryNone: Enter an amount to see the line diners get.

errors.blocked: Connect Stripe first: the deposit can be turned on once the account is active.
errors.enabled: Turn the deposit on or off.
errors.mode: Choose per guest or per booking.
errors.amount: Enter a whole amount from {min} to {max}.
errors.fromPartySize: Enter a party size from 1 to 1000.
errors.refundNote: The refund rule can be up to 500 characters.

agentSettings.title: AI reply agent
agentSettings.description: Let an AI agent answer diners' free-text WhatsApp questions using your restaurant info and each diner's own points.

modeHint.off: The agent never runs; diners get your fallback menu.
modeHint.shadow: The agent drafts a reply you can read in the AI agent log; diners still get the fallback menu.
modeHint.auto: The agent replies to diners directly, ending with the disclosure line.

agentSettings.knowledgeHint: Opening hours, menu highlights, how points work. The agent only answers from this and the diner's own points.
agentSettings.instructionsHint: Tone and style only, e.g. "Friendly, short, reply in the diner's language".
agentSettings.disclosureHint: Added to the end of every automatic reply. You can reword it; it can't be removed (left blank, the default comes back).
agentSettings.fallbackModelHint: Used once when the main model is overloaded or times out.

failureActionHint.handoff: The diner gets an apology and your contact link, and the conversation is marked "Needs staff". Recommended.
failureActionHint.menu: The diner gets the usual fallback menu.

toolHint.get_member_summary: The diner's own points and stamp cards.
toolHint.list_rewards: Your active rewards and their points cost.
toolHint.handoff_to_staff: Sends your contact link and pauses the agent for this diner.
toolHint.propose_booking: Checks the date, time, party size and name the diner gave and reads them back. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.create_booking_request: After the diner agrees, adds a pending request to Bookings for you to confirm. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.get_booking_link: Shares your online booking link. External booking mode only.
toolHint.list_my_bookings: The diner's own upcoming bookings. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.propose_booking_change: Checks a new date, time or party size and reads it back. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.confirm_booking_change: After the diner agrees, adds a change request to Bookings; the original stays until you confirm. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.propose_booking_cancel: Reads back the booking the diner wants to cancel. Simple booking mode only.
toolHint.confirm_booking_cancel: After the diner agrees, cancels the booking and texts the diner. Simple booking mode only.

knob.maxHistoryMessages: Messages of history sent to the model
knob.perCallTimeoutMs: Max wait for the model per call (ms)
knob.maxRepliesPerPhonePerHour: Max replies per diner per hour

field.maxHistoryMessages: messages of history sent to the model
field.perCallTimeoutMs: max wait for the model per call (ms)
field.maxRepliesPerPhonePerHour: max replies per diner per hour

agentSettings.stale: These settings were changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest before saving.
agentSettings.forbidden: Only an admin can change these settings.
agentSettings.loadFailed: Couldn't load the AI agent settings. Reload the page to try again.

agentLog.heading: AI agent
agentLog.description: Each diner conversation of the last 7 days, with the agent's draft or sent reply.
agentLog.adminOnly: Only an admin can read the AI agent conversations.
agentLog.emptyHint: Set the AI reply agent to Shadow or Auto in Settings; free-text messages from diners show up here.
agentLog.pickThread: Pick a conversation to read it.
agentLog.threadGone: This conversation is no longer available.

meaning.yellow: {yellow}% to under {green}% delivered. Some messages fail.
meaning.red: Under {yellow}% delivered, or Meta says the number can't receive WhatsApp.
meaning.unknown: No messages sent yet, e.g. new members. Always included.

campaignSettings.title: Campaigns
campaignSettings.description: Defaults for every new campaign. You can still change them on each campaign before it sends.
campaignSettings.qualityDescription: How reliably WhatsApp messages reached each member in the last {days} days.
campaignSettings.activeMembers: {count, plural, one {# active member} other {# active members}}
campaignSettings.skipHint: Leave them out of new campaigns automatically. Protects your number's quality rating with Meta.
campaignSettings.skipImpact: Today this skips {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}. Members with no data are always included, so new members still get their first message.
campaignSettings.winbackDescription: Who counts as a lapsed customer.
campaignSettings.lapsedHint: A member who hasn't visited for this many days. Used by win-back campaigns and the Last visit filter.
campaignSettings.thresholdsSummary: Green ≥ {green}% delivered · Yellow ≥ {yellow}% · Red below {yellow}% · last {days} days
campaignSettings.thresholdsReadOnly: These thresholds decide each contact's colour on the Members page and in campaigns. They can't be changed yet.
campaignSettings.saveNote: Changes apply to campaigns created after you save.
campaignSettings.saveError: Couldn't save. Your changes are kept, try again.
campaignSettings.readOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
